title: Team memory record (one line of .grokbot-team/memory/<topic>.jsonl)
description: Append-only shared memory for the templates in one game project. Version 1.0.0. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist). shared/team-memory/team-memory.mjs enforces this schema and also rejects personal data, which a schema alone cannot express.

time.description: When the record was written, ISO 8601 in UTC.

id.description: The writing template's id from its template.json.

version.description: The writing template's version from its template.json.

topic.description: Also the file name. A template writes only the topics listed in its template.json memory.writes.

kind.description: What happened, as a short kebab-case word, for example decision, incident-opened, grant-reviewed, value-changed, region-added, release-cut.

summary.description: One plain sentence a teammate can act on. No personal data.

data.description: Structured details, 4096 bytes at most. People and accounts appear only as hashed subject ids (sub_ plus 32 hex) under a key named subject or subjects.

source.description: Where the fact came from: pack, artifact, path, gitSha, liveSha or note. Never a URL.

confidence.description: measured: from an evidence pack or artifact; reported: a person said so; assumed: a clearly marked working assumption.

expires_at.description: After this UTC time the record is no longer active. null means it does not expire.

supersedes.description: The id of an earlier record in the same topic that this record replaces. Records are never edited or deleted.
